explication: Vue Vben Admin is a Vue 3 middle- and back-office admin template, offered as several UI-library variants. The principal workflow initializes app preferences, bootstraps the chosen frontend, and renders authenticated or public routes and their views; permissions support dynamic route generation. The graph also preserves documented themes and internationalization, plus the mock API and shared UI/runtime layers. Source excerpts and the index establish initialization links; unsampled route, API, and mock-handler connections are omitted rather than inferred.
